title: Weighted Extensions of Stein's Theorem for Linear and Multilinear Operators
summary: We study weighted estimates for linear and multilinear integral operators whose kernels satisfy only size conditions. Extending a theorem of E. Stein and its refinement by Soria and Weiss, we prove weighted estimates on Herz and Cesàro type spaces, together with multilinear strong-type and weak-type analogues. As applications, we derive consequences for a range of rough singular integral operators and related variants, including linear, oscillatory, and multilinear settings.
